scope: S2382 only; fixed Batch 032 membership otherwise unchanged
reason: A final schema/sibling-batch check showed that S2382's directly reported LEAF-Q low-energy-availability-risk prevalence (13/22; 59.1%) maps to the supported metabolic/nutritional illness fields. The initial no-payload classification was therefore corrected before handoff.

sourceEvidence.sourceCoverage: Primary PDF pp. 1-8; abstract, participant/method sections, Tables 1-4, results, discussion, conclusion, and references were already swept in the original source pass.
sourceEvidence.directOutcome: LEAF-Q score >=8 identified 13 of 22 players (59.1%) as at risk of problematic low energy availability.
sourceEvidence.mappingRationale: The direct result is a pooled metabolic/nutritional illness-risk prevalence. LEAF-Q is an indirect screen, so it is not recorded as a clinical diagnosis, and overlapping questionnaire outcomes are not summed into an artificial all-illness count.

stagedCorrection.coreTabs: Study details, participant characteristics, definitions, and exposure were completed using the standard core-tab not-reported rows where the source has no value.
